description: Aigine Redact detects and masks personal data and confidential information in documents. This opens a secure upload button so you can send a PDF, DOCX, PPTX or image (up to 50 MB) directly to Aigine's EU server. The file never passes through the chat. Returns an upload_id, valid for 15 minutes, for use with propose_masking.
name: create_upload_link
title: Aigine Redact – Upload document for redaction
